text.description_html:
Acorn DP-IMABP, Hand Forged Tuscan Extra Large Ring Pull

This ring pull is big--measuring a full 8-1/3 inches from top to bottom and 6-3/4 inches across--so it will be sure to make a bold statement. The Hand Forged Tuscan Extra Large Ring Pull is perfect for rustic decor making it a great accent for large doors and gates. It is surface mounted and comes with the necessary mounting hardware. The uneven surface of this iron pull duplicates that found on the ironwork of many European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered iron. Made by Acorn, the 8-1/3 Inch Tuscan Ring Pull has a lifetime no rust warranty.

Specifications of the Surface Mount Iron Art Tuscan Door Pull:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Height: 8-1/3"
  • Width: 6-3/4"
  • Projection: 2"
  • Surface mounted. Comes with mounting hardware.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Due to the handmade nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate. Sold individually (1 door pull handle)
